fot_deposit_received.binding: tokens actually received by the contract for bob's 1000-token Fee-on-Transfer deposit (PoC step 1; 990 after the 1% fee), observed in wei and scaled to report token units by /1e18

standard_deposit_received.binding: tokens received from a standard (no-fee) deposit; this PoC contains NO standard-token deposit at all, so the observable is 0 -- the report's 1000 comes from its narrative example, not from the PoC scenario

physical_balance.binding: the contract's actual token balance after both deposits (the PoC's value is 1980, not the report narrative's 1990), in report token units

total_liabilities.binding: sum of the public creatorBalance ledger entries after both deposits (2000 in the PoC), in report token units

poc.description: new-SC guard test Stage2InvariantGuard.testStage2InjectedInvariants: PoC scenario re-run with recorded logs; P/I/V expressions from stage-2 constraints.json evaluated against bound Solidity observables (forge, zero model calls)
